scene: Strapped with twin rocket thrusters, you zoom to the rooftop transit docks.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide rooftop skyport platform. On the far left, a steaming noodle-cart monorail sits on an elevated track. In the centre, a green bamboo cable car hangs ready. To the right of it stands the player with smoking rocket thrusters. On the far right, a giant paper-lantern balloon bobs.
